peerMapping.justification: This block isolates the return drivers of BRENTOIL by pairing it with one tightly correlated crude benchmark hedge and seven positively weighted peers spanning commodities, a broad equity index, and substitution-theme equities. Weights sum to exactly 1 and are assigned by economic comparability, tempered by each instrument's displayed 24-hour perp liquidity in USD millions so that more liquid comparables carry more weight: GOLD receives 0.22 on 23.982 USD millions, SILVER receives 0.20 on 32.581 USD millions, SP500 receives 0.18 on 50.729 USD millions, COPPER receives 0.12 on 6.262 USD millions, NATGAS receives 0.10 on 2.186 USD millions, TSLA receives 0.10 on 4.787 USD millions, and BE receives 0.08 on 1.355 USD millions. The hedge leg uses short CL exposure to neutralize the shared global oil supply-demand factor while preserving the refined macro and substitution sensitivities carried by the peer sleeve. All symbols come from CORE_UNIVERSE and every reason is specific rather than generic.

peers.name: Gold
peers.reason: Gold is the macro risk-off and inflation-hedge peer: oil-led inflation pressure can raise demand for gold, while acute risk-off episodes can push Brent and gold in opposite directions, so it captures the risk channel instead of direct barrel economics.

peers.name: Copper
peers.reason: Copper is a liquid industrial commodity whose returns are tied to the same global manufacturing, construction, and risk-on demand cycle that drives oil consumption; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 6.262 USD millions, below Brent at 36.44 USD millions but strong enough for a leading peer weight.

peers.name: S&P 500
peers.reason: The S&P 500 is the broad risk-on growth proxy: stronger expected economic activity can lift equities and crude together, while recession fear can hit both through the demand channel, making it a macro comparability peer rather than an energy sector peer.

peers.name: Silver
peers.reason: Precious-metal risk-off channel plus an industrial-demand side, giving it the same dollar and inflation sensitivity as gold and part of the same global-growth sensitivity as oil-linked commodities; displayed liquidity of 32.581 USD millions backs a 0.20 weight.

peers.name: Natural gas
peers.reason: Natural gas shares the energy-complex channel with Brent through fuel substitution, power generation economics, and the same global growth and inventory cycle; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.186 USD millions, far below Brent at 36.44 USD millions, so the weight is meaningful but capped.

peers.name: Tesla
peers.reason: Substitute relationship in transport fuel: electric vehicle adoption erodes long-run gasoline demand, so Tesla trades as an equity proxy for the energy-transition theme that caps crude's long-run demand; displayed liquidity of 4.787 USD millions supports a 0.10 weight.

primary_index_hedge.name: WTI crude oil
primary_index_hedge.reason: WTI crude oil is the closest substitute benchmark to Brent crude oil: both are crude benchmarks exposed to refinery demand, inventories, geopolitical supply risk, and the wider oil complex. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 40.091 USD millions, which makes the primary hedge practical to size.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's TradeXYZ close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
